findings.title: /IN trace width is only 0.50 mm while the buck converter can draw up to 3 A
findings.why: The narrow trace will cause excessive voltage drop and heating, risking regulator failure or undervoltage to the MCU
findings.fix: Widen the /IN trace to at least 1.5 mm (≈0.5 mm per amp) or split the current over multiple parallel traces

findings.title: VBST trace width is only 0.50 mm but must carry the buck converter inductor current (~3 A)
findings.why: Insufficient copper leads to high resistance, voltage drop and possible overheating of the trace
findings.fix: Increase VBST trace width to ≥1.5 mm or provide a copper pour for the high‑current path

findings.title: +5V trace width is 0.50 mm, which is marginal for the expected 2 A+ load of servos and stepper driver
findings.why: Undersized trace can cause voltage sag and overheating, leading to brown‑outs of the driver circuitry
findings.fix: Widen the +5V traces to at least 1 mm or create a dedicated +5V copper pour/power plane

findings.title: +3.3V trace width is only 0.30 mm, which supports roughly 0.6 A, but the LDO and MCU together can draw >1 A
findings.why: The thin trace may cause noticeable voltage drop and instability for the MCU and peripheral circuits
findings.fix: Increase +3.3V trace width to ≥0.9 mm or add a copper pour to provide adequate current capacity

findings.title: NRST net has only a decoupling capacitor and no pull‑up resistor to the supply rail
findings.why: The reset pin can float, causing unintended resets or failure to start the MCU reliably
findings.fix: Add a 10 kΩ pull‑up resistor from /NRST to +3.3 V

findings.title: The +5 V net has no local decoupling capacitors placed near the ULN2003 or servo headers
findings.why: Absence of decoupling can lead to voltage spikes and noise that disturb the stepper driver and servo operation
findings.fix: Place 0.1 µF (and optionally 10 µF) ceramic capacitors close to each +5 V load point

findings.title: Inductor L1 is listed without a specified inductance or current rating
findings.why: Without a defined value the buck converter cannot be correctly designed and may not meet performance or reliability targets
findings.fix: Specify the required inductance (e.g., 4.7 µH) and current rating (≥3 A) and ensure the part is available from a supplier

findings.title: Ferrite bead FB1 has no impedance or current rating defined
findings.why: An inappropriate bead could either provide insufficient filtering or introduce excessive loss
findings.fix: Add the required ferrite bead specification (e.g., 600 Ω @ 100 MHz, 2 A) to the BOM
